blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several big-ticket Indian companies are looking to invest a combined $66.78 million to expand or establish operations in the Philippines. These investment prospects were presented during a roundtable between President Marcos and Indian business leaders, also attended by Finance Secretary Frederick Go and Trade Secretary Cristina Roque.
